cohort: 130 pregnant females attending the Antenatal Clinic during 9 months of pregnancy suspected of having Leptospirosis.
finding: Out of 130 suspected cases, 14 (10.76%) tested positive for Leptospirosis by ELISA, and these patients experienced adverse pregnancy outcomes including abortion, stillbirth, and premature labor.
mod_finding: Of the women who tested positive for Leptospirosis, most delivered vaginally (50%), some had cesarean sections (21.42%), and others experienced abortions or stillbirth (21.42% and 7.14% respectively).
birth_weight: Of the live births among the suspected Leptospirosis cases: 0% ELBW (<1 kg), 0% VLBW (<1.5kg), 30% LBW (<2.5 kg), 60% Normal for Gestational Age (2.5-<4 kg), 10% LGA (>=4 kg).
